because: Counterexample (hunt 2026-10-10): a recognized line already buffered before a signal was written was taken as its answer. A node answering one request with two lines settled the next signal, whose own answer was unknown, as Applied; a line appended to the ACK answer retired a signal the node never answered. Fix: Conn::exchange refuses bytes that arrived before the request and drops the connection, keeping the signal queued.
statement: Transport failure, unknown reply or missing terminating LF retains an unexpired obligation. A complete recognized final reply removes it; bounded overflow and an opt-in forwarding deadline are explicit, separately counted local loss paths. ACK outcome is node acceptance/refusal, not proof of durable storage or completed kernel enforcement.
